reply_text:
I estimate the build is about 70% done: 20.5 of 29 major packets, each worth about 3.4%. Seven are not started (P7b, P8, P12, P15, P16, P18, P19, P21 are the gaps, with P19 only decided so far), and two of the nearly finished ones, P10 and P11, can't run live until you answer the two grant questions.

```
M-象-2000  [██████████████░░░░░░]  ~70%   (20.5 of 29 packets)
```

The build plan has 29 major packets. For each one I've taken the fraction of its sub-packets that are done.

| Packet | Done | Note |
|---|---|---|
| P0, P1, P2a, P2b, P3, P4, P5, P6, P6o, P6b, P7a, P13a, P13b, P14, P17, P20, P22 | 17 × 100% | P5 and P14 were deliberately narrowed; I've counted each as finished at its narrowed scope |
| P10, retracting a pattern card by inference | 95% | Built and live; it waits on your grant for 象 |
| P11, offers and agreements | ~90% | 8 of 9 sub-packets done; P11-6 (recording a refused `yes`) is with codex-5 now |
| P9, what each agent owes | ~90% | P9-0 to P9-3 done; questions about a past time still time out |
| P2c, crash tests | ~75% | The tests and one fix are done; other fixes may remain |
| P7b, P8, P12, P15, P16, P18, P21 | 0% | Not started |
| P19 | 0% | Decided (象 reads only your turns), but not built |

The fractions are my judgment rather than exact sub-packet counts. The series weren't planned with a known length, so a percentage like "P11-6 is one sixth of P11" isn't available. P11 ended up with nine sub-packets because gaps were found along the way.

What would move the bar most:
1. **Your two grants.** They wouldn't add new packets, but they'd turn P10 and P11 from tested with stubs into running live, which is the last step for both.
2. **P8, the automatic check of whether a promise was kept.** P9 now works around its absence, so building it would firm up P9 as well.
3. **P18, answers stating their population and time.** P9's answers already partly do this, so it's a small start.
